project: Interactive Map - Pin Positioning & Properties Enhancement
description: Fix pin drag-and-drop positioning bug and enhance pin properties UI with size, color, icon management, and zoom-based visibility controls

userStories.title: Fix Pin Drag-and-Drop Positioning Bug
userStories.description: Pins currently teleport back to their original position after being dragged and dropped. This is caused by the component re-rendering with stale data from the server before the local state update is applied. Need to ensure proper optimistic updates and prevent race conditions between local store updates and server responses.
acceptanceCriteria: User can drag a pin to a new position
On mouse up, pin stays at the new position (no teleporting)
New position is saved to database successfully
Optimistic UI update prevents visual flickering
Position persists after page refresh
Console logs confirm successful database update
No race conditions between local state and server response
userStories.notes: Issue: Pin position updates in database (confirmed by console logs) but component re-renders with old position. Root cause: TanStack Query cache invalidation triggers refetch before Zustand store updates are applied. Solution: Ensure Zustand update happens immediately, disable cache refetch during optimistic update, or use mutation cache update instead of invalidation.

userStories.title: Display Pin Properties in Sidebar When Selected
userStories.description: When a pin is selected, the sidebar's 'Pin Properties' section should display comprehensive pin settings including: title, description, type, coordinates (read-only), and NEW: size, color, icon, opacity, visibility, and zoom range. Currently the section exists but doesn't show all available properties from the database schema.

Opacity slider shows current opacity (0-100%)
Visibility toggle shows current state
Coordinates display current lat/lng (read-only)
Changes apply immediately with optimistic UI updates
Form validation prevents invalid values
Success toast shows after saving
userStories.notes: PinPropertiesSection component already exists at src/components/world/ui/pin-properties-section.tsx. Need to verify all fields are properly wired to the form state and updatePin action. Check use-properties-panel.ts for form state management.
